problems.title: Words Within Two Edits of Dictionary
problems.pattern: Bounded Hamming distance across equal-length words
problems.invariant: A query qualifies if any dictionary word differs in at most two positions.
problems.drill_target: Implement the simple O(q*n*l) version first; discuss hash/trie only if time remains.

problems.title: Removing Stars From a String
problems.invariant: Each star deletes the closest live character to its left, exactly like popping a stack.
problems.drill_target: Write the stack solution without overthinking string deletion.

problems.title: Maximum Score From Removing Stones
problems.invariant: The score cannot exceed half the total moves or the total outside the largest pile.
problems.drill_target: Derive and implement min(total // 2, total - max_pile).

problems.title: Ways to Make a Fair Array
problems.invariant: After deleting index i, the suffix swaps parity while the prefix keeps parity.
problems.drill_target: Track prefix even/odd and suffix even/odd in one pass.

problems.title: Sum Game
problems.pattern: Game theory on digit-sum imbalance and question-mark counts
problems.invariant: Bob can force equality only when the remaining question marks can exactly offset the current half-sum difference.
problems.drill_target: Memorize the compact condition, then explain why odd question-mark imbalance favors Alice.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array
problems.pattern: Longest increasing subsequence from both sides
problems.invariant: A valid peak needs a nonempty increasing arm on the left and decreasing arm on the right.
problems.drill_target: Compute LIS lengths left-to-right and right-to-left, then subtract the best mountain length from n.
